Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Placements read 2026-09-16: d4builds S (5th in S; the only Barbarian S) — "Charge Barb (S15)", Rob2628, last updated 2026-09-14; InfinityBuilds Pushing A (only Barbarian entry; "Flame Charge (Tier Push)", 张胖胖, updated 2026-09-14), absent from InfinityBuilds Endgame; Maxroll Push S (5th of 8) and Endgame A (6th) — guide "Charge Barbarian", Last Updated 2026-09-15, planner z8493e0q. Core agreed by all three: Charge with the Battering Ram upgrade ("removes the delayed swing … leaving a Burning trail in your wake. This trail is where almost all of your damage comes from", Maxroll); Chainscourged Mail is mandatory ("Without it, Charge has an enormous base cooldown of 17 seconds", Maxroll); Shattered Vow, Rage of Harrogath, Fists of Fate, Ramaladni's Magnum Opus; Steel Grasp for Chainscourged Mail's two-Brawling-skill bonus (d4builds, Maxroll Push, InfinityBuilds); Damage-over-Time and Fire multipliers with Fire transfigurations; Sescheron's Fury + Berserker's Crucible charms; Brawl/Executioner/Disembowel glyphs. Disagreements resolved by weighting (d4builds > InfinityBuilds > Maxroll): bar with Steel Grasp (d4builds, Maxroll Push, InfinityBuilds) over Challenging Shout (Maxroll Endgame) — d4builds: "We are now playing with Steel Grasp to pull in enemies as Ground Stomp x20% vs Burning does NOT work for Charge!"; helm Leoric's Crown (d4builds, Maxroll) over Tuskhelm of Joritz the Mighty (InfinityBuilds; d4builds' own stale "Requirements" line); amulet Aspect of Disobedience transfigured with Battle-Mad (d4builds) over Wanton Rupture + Overheating (Maxroll) and Melted Heart of Selig (InfinityBuilds); bludgeon Writhing Aspect legendary (d4builds, Maxroll Push) over The Furnace (Maxroll Endgame); mercenary Raheir + Varyana (d4builds) over Subo + Varyana (Maxroll) and Subo + Raheir (InfinityBuilds). 3.2.1 context (Blizzard patch notes, read 2026-09-16): core stat scaling 1.1% → 0.8% per 10 Strength; Writhing Aspect 6–9%[x]; Disembowel Glyph 15%[x], Hemorrhage 60%[x], Blood Rage 45%[x]; Rage of Harrogath cooldown reduction 1 s → 0.5 s; Ramaladni's Magnum Opus drains 7% of Maximum Fury in combat; Battering Ram impact now matches its visual. Launch-week placements; one creator Pit 150 clear is on record. Whirlwind (d4builds' first Barbarian in A) is not carried: no reference publishes a Season 15 Whirlwind endgame or push loadout yet. Soul Splinter cap caveat: the official text is 'You can equip up to three Soul Splinters among available Jewelry slots' and Leoric's Crown counts as Jewelry, yet every Season 15 reference loadout read on 2026-09-16 sockets more than three - unverified, re-verify in game [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394/celebrate-30-years-of-diablo-in-season-of-hell-s-legacy - 2026-09-16].

Rotation
  1. Keep Rallying Cry up and Wrath of the Berserker, Iron Skin and War Cry on cooldown; cast Steel Grasp to pull and arm Chainscourged Mail, then Charge in medium-length lines so the burning trail does the damage.
Variants

Leveling — No reference publishes a 1-70 Charge route, and Maxroll warns not to play this build without first acquiring Chainscourged Mail; this stage is Maxroll's level-70 'Starter'. Charge between the screen edge and the target; Iron Skin (Retaliation) on cooldown; Rallying Cry every 4 seconds; War Cry and Challenging Shout off cooldown; Wrath of the Berserker when it is up — 'pick your battles wisely' (Maxroll Starter notes, 2026-09-16).
Move on when Swap when Leoric's Crown and Rage of Harrogath are equipped and you can fill the crown with two splinters (Hellfire + Pain).

Early Endgame — As leveling: Charge between the screen edge and the target; Iron Skin on cooldown; Rallying Cry every 4 seconds; War Cry and Challenging Shout off cooldown; Wrath of the Berserker when up. The Berserker's Crucible set, 'casting a random Shout every 5 seconds', offsets Shout uptime (Maxroll, 2026-09-16).
Move on when Swap when Shattered Vow and Fists of Fate drop: move to the Steel Grasp bar and the Sescheron's Fury + Crucible charm split.

Late Endgame — Maintain Rallying Cry; Wrath of the Berserker, Iron Skin and Challenging Shout (auto-cast via Lac) on cooldown; cast Steel Grasp first, then Charge — 'This skill needs to be on cooldown in order for Charge to get the damage bonus' (Maxroll). Charge in medium-length lines toward the screen edge — short bursts on top of the target 'roughly halves your DoT damage' (Maxroll). d4builds' rotation line still says 'First Cast Ground Stomp then Charge' — stale; its bar and intro use Steel Grasp (both read 2026-09-16).
Move on when Move to the push setup when Shattered Vow, Fists of Fate and Chainscourged Mail are Mythic and you reach 60% Cooldown Reduction (InfinityBuilds' floor for full Wrath of the Berserker uptime).

Pushing — As late_endgame: Rallying Cry maintained; Wrath of the Berserker, Iron Skin and Challenging Shout (Lac) on cooldown; Steel Grasp first, then Charge in medium-length lines toward the screen edge (Maxroll, 2026-09-16).

Stat requirements
  • You need 60+ cooldown reduction to keep Wrath of the Berserker fully covered (InfinityBuilds, Flame Charge Tier Push, 2026-09-16)
Records
  • Pit 150 clear — 'Fire Barb Pit 150', the build author's own claim on the d4builds Charge Barb (S15) page (read 2026-09-16) Creator claim with a Twitch clip; not a leaderboard placement. The same clear is the title of the showcase video 9EQPbErRKeg. Proof →

How to run them

d4builds Charge Barb (S15), read 2026-09-16; Raheir's own skill picks are in d4builds' encoded tree and are not recorded. Maxroll hires Subo (Incendiary Bolt, Scorched Earth, Snipe, Molotov — 'Molotov with Scorched Earth increases your DoT damage') with the same Varyana reinforcement, and suggests Aldkin (Field of Languish) for defence; InfinityBuilds hires Subo with Raheir's Bastion on Charge.

Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Placements read 2026-09-16: d4builds S (5th in S; the only Barbarian S) — "Charge Barb (S15)", Rob2628, last updated 2026-09-14; InfinityBuilds Pushing A (only Barbarian entry; "Flame Charge (Tier Push)", 张胖胖, updated 2026-09-14), absent from InfinityBuilds Endgame; Maxroll Push S (5th of 8) and Endgame A (6th) — guide "Charge Barbarian", Last Updated 2026-09-15, planner z8493e0q. Core agreed by all three: Charge with the Battering Ram upgrade ("removes the delayed swing … leaving a Burning trail in your wake. This trail is where almost all of your damage comes from", Maxroll); Chainscourged Mail is mandatory ("Without it, Charge has an enormous base cooldown of 17 seconds", Maxroll); Shattered Vow, Rage of Harrogath, Fists of Fate, Ramaladni's Magnum Opus; Steel Grasp for Chainscourged Mail's two-Brawling-skill bonus (d4builds, Maxroll Push, InfinityBuilds); Damage-over-Time and Fire multipliers with Fire transfigurations; Sescheron's Fury + Berserker's Crucible charms; Brawl/Executioner/Disembowel glyphs. Disagreements resolved by weighting (d4builds > InfinityBuilds > Maxroll): bar with Steel Grasp (d4builds, Maxroll Push, InfinityBuilds) over Challenging Shout (Maxroll Endgame) — d4builds: "We are now playing with Steel Grasp to pull in enemies as Ground Stomp x20% vs Burning does NOT work for Charge!"; helm Leoric's Crown (d4builds, Maxroll) over Tuskhelm of Joritz the Mighty (InfinityBuilds; d4builds' own stale "Requirements" line); amulet Aspect of Disobedience transfigured with Battle-Mad (d4builds) over Wanton Rupture + Overheating (Maxroll) and Melted Heart of Selig (InfinityBuilds); bludgeon Writhing Aspect legendary (d4builds, Maxroll Push) over The Furnace (Maxroll Endgame); mercenary Raheir + Varyana (d4builds) over Subo + Varyana (Maxroll) and Subo + Raheir (InfinityBuilds). 3.2.1 context (Blizzard patch notes, read 2026-09-16): core stat scaling 1.1% → 0.8% per 10 Strength; Writhing Aspect 6–9%[x]; Disembowel Glyph 15%[x], Hemorrhage 60%[x], Blood Rage 45%[x]; Rage of Harrogath cooldown reduction 1 s → 0.5 s; Ramaladni's Magnum Opus drains 7% of Maximum Fury in combat; Battering Ram impact now matches its visual. Launch-week placements; one creator Pit 150 clear is on record. Whirlwind (d4builds' first Barbarian in A) is not carried: no reference publishes a Season 15 Whirlwind endgame or push loadout yet. Soul Splinter cap caveat: the official text is 'You can equip up to three Soul Splinters among available Jewelry slots' and Leoric's Crown counts as Jewelry, yet every Season 15 reference loadout read on 2026-09-16 sockets more than three - unverified, re-verify in game [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394/celebrate-30-years-of-diablo-in-season-of-hell-s-legacy - 2026-09-16].

Rotation
  1. Keep Rallying Cry up and Wrath of the Berserker, Iron Skin and War Cry on cooldown; cast Steel Grasp to pull and arm Chainscourged Mail, then Charge in medium-length lines so the burning trail does the damage.
Variants

Leveling — No reference publishes a 1-70 Charge route, and Maxroll warns not to play this build without first acquiring Chainscourged Mail; this stage is Maxroll's level-70 'Starter'. Charge between the screen edge and the target; Iron Skin (Retaliation) on cooldown; Rallying Cry every 4 seconds; War Cry and Challenging Shout off cooldown; Wrath of the Berserker when it is up — 'pick your battles wisely' (Maxroll Starter notes, 2026-09-16).
Move on when Swap when Leoric's Crown and Rage of Harrogath are equipped and you can fill the crown with two splinters (Hellfire + Pain).

Early Endgame — As leveling: Charge between the screen edge and the target; Iron Skin on cooldown; Rallying Cry every 4 seconds; War Cry and Challenging Shout off cooldown; Wrath of the Berserker when up. The Berserker's Crucible set, 'casting a random Shout every 5 seconds', offsets Shout uptime (Maxroll, 2026-09-16).
Move on when Swap when Shattered Vow and Fists of Fate drop: move to the Steel Grasp bar and the Sescheron's Fury + Crucible charm split.

Late Endgame — Maintain Rallying Cry; Wrath of the Berserker, Iron Skin and Challenging Shout (auto-cast via Lac) on cooldown; cast Steel Grasp first, then Charge — 'This skill needs to be on cooldown in order for Charge to get the damage bonus' (Maxroll). Charge in medium-length lines toward the screen edge — short bursts on top of the target 'roughly halves your DoT damage' (Maxroll). d4builds' rotation line still says 'First Cast Ground Stomp then Charge' — stale; its bar and intro use Steel Grasp (both read 2026-09-16).
Move on when Move to the push setup when Shattered Vow, Fists of Fate and Chainscourged Mail are Mythic and you reach 60% Cooldown Reduction (InfinityBuilds' floor for full Wrath of the Berserker uptime).

Pushing — As late_endgame: Rallying Cry maintained; Wrath of the Berserker, Iron Skin and Challenging Shout (Lac) on cooldown; Steel Grasp first, then Charge in medium-length lines toward the screen edge (Maxroll, 2026-09-16).

Stat requirements
  • You need 60+ cooldown reduction to keep Wrath of the Berserker fully covered (InfinityBuilds, Flame Charge Tier Push, 2026-09-16)
Records
  • Pit 150 clear — 'Fire Barb Pit 150', the build author's own claim on the d4builds Charge Barb (S15) page (read 2026-09-16) Creator claim with a Twitch clip; not a leaderboard placement. The same clear is the title of the showcase video 9EQPbErRKeg. Proof →

To chain the kin of Bul-Kathos is to gift them a weapon.

Upheaval's Fury cost is reduced to 28 Fury.

Overpower

UpgradeUpheaval

Upheaval consumes 1 Overpower stack to increase Upheaval's Size by 20%[+] and damage by 20%[x].

Free Cast

UpgradeUpheaval

Every 100 Fury spent makes your next Upheaval free to cast. This stacks up to 300 total Fury.

Slice and Dice

UpgradeDouble Swing

Sweep Size increased by 200% but Cast Speed is slowed by 40%. Enemies caught at the outer edge of your sweeps and are hit an additional time for 90% damage.

These additional hits grant this Skill 5% increased Cast Speed for 4 seconds, stacking up to 8 times.

Fortify

UpgradeDouble Swing

Fortifies you for 1% of your Maximum Life for each enemy hit with both weapons.

Chance to Hit Twice

UpgradeDouble Swing

Gains 20% chance to hit twice.

Fury Cost Reduction

UpgradeDouble Swing

Decreases the Fury Cost of your next Double Swing per hit by 2 once per weapon.

Damage Increase

UpgradeDouble Swing

Increases this Skill's damage by 2%[x] per enemy hit for 2 seconds, all stacks expire simultaneously and the duration cannot be refreshed.

Flailing

UpgradeRend

Rend gains 40%[+] increased Size and 40%[x] increased damage. Consecutive swings of Rend further increases its Size by 20%[+], up to 60%[+], until you stop swinging.

Cast Speed

UpgradeRend

Rend gains 20%[+] increased Cast Speed.

Healing

UpgradeRend

Heal for 1% of your Maximum Life per second for each enemy Bleeding from Rend.

Moving Damage Bonus

UpgradeRend

Rend deals 25%[x] increased damage to enemies that are moving.

Vulnerable Damage Bonus

UpgradeRend

Rend deals 20%[x] increased damage to Vulnerable enemies.

Madness

UpgradeKick

You dash towards your enemy and deliver a powerful kick that deals 175% and Knocks Down enemies for 4 seconds.

Kick is additionally a Mobility Skill.

Increase Damage

UpgradeKick

Moving increases Kick's damage by up to 20%[x].

Vulnerable

UpgradeKick

Kick makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

Collide

UpgradeKick

Kicked enemies deal 20% damage to enemies they collide with. Additionally, Kick destroys certain objects from Elite monster affixes.

Cooldown Reduction

UpgradeKick

Kicking an enemy reduces the Cooldowns of your Mobility Skills by 2 seconds.

Slow

UpgradeWar Cry

War Cry Slows nearby enemies by 20% for 4 seconds.

Vulnerable

UpgradeWar Cry

War Cry makes nearby enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

Unstoppable

UpgradeCharge

You are Unstoppable during Charge.

Cooldown Reduction

UpgradeCharge

Charge's Cooldown is reduced by 1 second for each enemy it hit, up to 3.

Mosh

UpgradeLeap

Leap Summons 3 Ancients that Leap at a random enemy and deal 13.75% damage.

Arsenal Bonus

UpgradeLeap

Dual Wield: 2 seconds of Berserking

Bludgeoning: 1 stack of Overpower

Slashing: 1 stack of Ferocity

Leap grants a bonus based on its Arsenal Selection

Fury Generation

UpgradeLeap

Leap now generates 20 Fury.

Pull

UpgradeLeap

Leap now Pulls In enemies upon landing.

Damage Bonus and Crowd Control

UpgradeLeap

Leap deals 20%[x] increased damage and Knocks Down enemies for 1 second.

Breach

UpgradeGround Stomp

Ground Stomp becomes a Brawling Skill that deals Fire damage.

Ground Stomp no longer Stuns and smashes the surrounding ground. Instead, it fissures the ground in front of you, dealing 150% damage. Burning enemies take 20%[x] increased damage.

Fury Generation

UpgradeGround Stomp

Increases the Fury generated by Ground Stomp to 30.

Additional Charges

UpgradeGround Stomp

Ground Stomp gains 2 additional Charges.

Size Bonus

UpgradeGround Stomp

Ground Stomp gains 20%[+] increased Size.

Damage Bonus

UpgradeGround Stomp

Ground Stomp deals 20%[x] increased damage.

Retaliation

UpgradeIron Skin

Iron Skin no longer grants a Barrier. Instead you reflect Iron Shrapnel when attacked, dealing 5% damage and inflicting 50% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

Iron Skin's duration is tripled.

Duration Bonus

UpgradeRallying Cry

Rallying Cry's duration is increased to 7 seconds.

Fury Gain

UpgradeRallying Cry

For every 3 meter traveled while Rallying Cry is active, restore 2 primary resource to yourself and half to nearby allies.

Movement Speed

UpgradeIron Skin

Iron Skin increases your Movement Speed by 15%[x].

Weaken

UpgradeIron Skin

Enemies attacking you while Iron Skin is active become Weakened for 3 seconds.

Resolve

UpgradeIron Skin

Iron Skin grants 2 stacks of Resolve when cast.

Fury Generation

UpgradeChallenging Shout

Taking damage while Challenging Shout is active will generate 3 Fury.

Duration Bonus

UpgradeChallenging Shout

Challenging Shout's duration is increased by 2 seconds.

Blast

UpgradeDeath Blow

Death Blow now deals Fire damage and deals an additional 225% Burning damage over 5 seconds.

Enemies that die to Death Blow while Burning or to Death Blow's burn trigger a fiery explosion for 30% damage to surrounding enemies.

Execute

UpgradeDeath Blow

Enemies you hit with Death Blow can be Executed by any of your attacks for the next 2 seconds, resetting Death Blow's cooldown on a successful Execution

Overpower

UpgradeDeath Blow

Death Blow grants 1 stack of Overpower when it kills an enemy.

Fury Generation

UpgradeDeath Blow

Killing an enemy with Death Blow restores 100% of your Fury.

Charges

UpgradeDeath Blow

Death Blow has 2 charges.

All For One

UpgradeRupture

Casting Rupture Summons 2 Ancients that skewer your target for 20% damage and then performing a rip attack that deals 140% as direct damage instead of Bleeding.

Size Bonus

UpgradeRupture

Rupture's Size is increased by 25%.

Damage Bonus

UpgradeRupture

Rupture deals 25%[x] increased damage. Each subsequent enemy Hit reduces this bonus by 5%.

Cooldown Reduction

UpgradeRupture

Ripping your weapon out of enemies reduces Rupture's Cooldown by 1 second.

Healing

UpgradeRupture

Heal for 22% of your Maximum Life on Hit.

Mightiest

UpgradeMighty Throw

Mighty Throw is now an Ultimate Skill that drops a massive weapon for 542.5% damage with a 6 second cooldown.

This cooldown cannot be reduced by Cooldown Reduction.

Solo Chain

UpgradeSteel Grasp

Steel Grasp becomes a Basic Skill that has no Cooldown, generates up to 15 Fury based on Charges, but only throws a single chain.

Barrier

UpgradeMighty Throw

Mighty Throw generates up to {x} of your Maximum Life ({x}) as a Barrier for 6 seconds.

Size Bonus

UpgradeMighty Throw

Increase Mighty Throw's damage radius by 20%.

Extra Charges

UpgradeSteel Grasp

Steel Grasp gains 2 Charges.

Weaken

UpgradeSteel Grasp

Steel Grasp Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.

Empowered

UpgradeCall of the Ancients

Your Ancients are empowered:

Korlic creates an Earthquake that deals 99% Physical damage over 4 seconds when he leaps.

Talic leaves behind Dust Devils that deal 72% damage while he whirlwinds.

Madawc ignites the earth, Burning enemies for an additional 22.5% damage over 4 seconds when he upheaves the ground.

Highlander

UpgradeCall of the Ancients

Summon a single, permanent Ancient. Using this skill again replaces it with the next Ancient.

Damage Bonus

UpgradeCall of the Ancients

You and each of your Ancients summoned from this Skill increase each other's damage by 7%[x].

Damage Reduction

UpgradeCall of the Ancients

When you Cast Call of the Ancients, gain 5% Damage Reduction for each Ancient summoned while they are active.

Ancient Attack Speed

UpgradeCall of the Ancients

Your Ancients attack 25%[+] faster.

Attack Speed and Damage Bonus

UpgradeCall of the Ancients

When you Cast Call of the Ancients, gain 5%[+] Attack Speed and 5%[x] increased damage for each Ancient summoned for 6 seconds.

Hidden Technique

UpgradeIron Maelstrom

Iron Maelstrom now has 3 Charges and it always uses the same attack that matches your last used weapon at 75%[x] increased damage.

Armageddon

UpgradeIron Maelstrom

Each attack gains an additional effect:

Two Handed Bludgeoning creates a Earthquake that deals 135% Physical damage over 4 seconds,

Two-Handed Slashing shoots Iron Shrapnel dealing 3.6% damage inflicting 216% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds

Dual Wield forms Dust Devils that each deal 12.9% damage.

Cooldown Reduction

UpgradeIron Maelstrom

Weapon swaps reduce the Cooldown of Iron Maelstrom is by 2 second.

Global Cooldown Reduction

UpgradeIron Maelstrom

Activating Iron Maelstrom reduces all other active Cooldowns by 2 seconds.

Weaken

UpgradeIron Maelstrom

Enemies damaged by Iron Maelstrom Weakened for 4 seconds.

Additional Effect

UpgradeIron Maelstrom

Each attack gains an additional effect:

Two Handed Bludgeoning deals 25%[x] increased Critical Strike Damage

Two Handed Slashing deals 20%[x] increased damage to Vulnerable enemies.

Dual Wield gains 20%[+] Cast Speed.

Deep Impact

UpgradeWrath of the Berserker

While Wrath of the Berserker is active, all attacks causes a fiery explosion for 75% damage.

Overpower

UpgradeWrath of the Berserker

Wrath of the Berserker grants 1 stack of Overpower per second.

Fury Generation

UpgradeWrath of the Berserker

While Wrath of the Berserker is active, gain 20%[+] Attack Speed and increase Fury Generation by 30%[x].

Ferocity

UpgradeMighty Throw

Grants 3 stacks of Ferocity each time you use Mighty Throw.

Overpower

UpgradeMighty Throw

Mighty Throw now consumes one of your Overpower stacks to deal 20%[x] increased damage.

Provoke

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 25 seconds

Raheir Taunts enemies around you for 5 seconds. You gain 5% Damage Reduction for each target, up to 20%.

Ground Slam

Core skillRaheir

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Weapon: Round Shield

Basic Attack: Shield Strike

Raheir brutalizes the ground, dealing 160% Physical damage and Slowing enemies by 30% for 6 seconds. Targets in the center of the slam are Slowed by 60% instead.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Raheir swings a round shield at enemies, dealing 85% Physical damage. Every 20 swings, Raheir Heals you for 8% of your Maximum Life.

Shield Charge

Core skillRaheir

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Weapon: Tower Shield

Basic Attack: Shield Bash

Raheir rushes forward aggressively, dealing 110% Physical damage and Taunting nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Raheir bashes enemies with a tower shield, dealing 80% Physical damage and Fortifying you for 0.2% of your Maximum Life.

Crater

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 22 seconds

Raheir strikes the ground 3 times, each burst dealing 30% Physical damage and Pulling In enemies. The final burst deals 40% more Physical damage and additionally Stuns enemies for 2 secondseconds.

Raheir's Guard

PassiveRaheir

Raheir grants you 15%[+] Armor.

Vanguard

PassiveRaheir

Raheir Slows surrounding enemies by 40%.

Mocking Lure

PassiveRaheir

You deal 15%[x] increased damage to enemies Taunted by Raheir.

Iron Wolf's Ward

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he Knocks Back Close enemies and Taunts Distant enemies for 4 seconds.

Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 35%.

Iron Wolf's Call

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, your next 4 Core Skills within 10 seconds deal 25%[x] increased damage and cost no Resource.

Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 25%.

Sundering Shield

PassiveRaheir

Raheir's final Crater burst deals 200%[x] increased damage and inflicts Vulnerable on enemies for 4 seconds.

Shield Throw

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 22 seconds

Raheir throws his shield, dealing 450% Physical damage and Taunting enemies for 5 seconds. The shield bounces up to 9 times and cannot bounce to the same target twice.

Iron Wolf's Arrival

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he also casts Ground Slam and Shield Throw.

Raheir's Valiance's Cooldown is reduced by 35%.

Consecrated Shield

PassiveRaheir

Raheir's Shield Throw Consecrates enemies for 6 seconds. Directly damaging a Consecrated enemy Heals you for 6% of your Maximum Life, once per target.

Bastion

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 30 seconds

Raheir takes a protective position for 5 seconds, redirecting 90% of the damage that would be dealt to surrounding allies to himself for 5 seconds.

Bastion's initial cast also grants surrounding allies Unstoppable for 1.0 secondseconds.

Iron Wolf's Virtue

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he Heals you for 25% of your Maximum Life.

Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 35%.

Inspiration

PassiveRaheir

Enemies affected by Raheir's Ground Slam take 15%[x] increased damage.

Allies affected by Raheir's Bastion deal 25%[x] increased damage.

Raheir's Aegis

PassiveRaheir

Raheir grants you 15% Resistance to All Elements.

Draw Fire

PassiveRaheir

When you use a Healing Potion, Raheir Taunts enemies around him for 4 seconds. Can only occur once every 20 seconds.
